parsedVerdict.reasoning: The controller is a thin HTTP transport adapter. It maps the routes POST /orders and GET /orders/:id, pulls values out of the request body and path parameters, and hands each call to the injected OrderService. It contains no business rules (no pricing, validation logic or state changes), no persistence and no infrastructure code. Its only responsibilities are routing, request binding and delegation, which all belong to the presentation layer. Returning OrderEntity directly is a question of dependency or exposure, not a misplaced responsibility.
